extension.summary: Browse and play the Fan Edit Fan Club collection
extension.description: Browse the whole Fan Edit Fan Club collection by collection folder or genre, search it, and play edits with artwork, descriptions and ratings. It reads the same live catalogue as the FEFC web app and Fire TV app (fefc-collection.pages.dev), so all three always match.
extension.disclaimer: Fan edits are fan-made works. This add-on only streams the files in the shared collection.
